description: UEHI scoring factor directions (6-factor model). The six factors and their directions are authoritative. The numerical config weights provided here are baseline/default/reference values only. Production UEHI runs do NOT use them and instead calculate entropy-derived weights dynamically from the actual factor matrix. water_availability formally investigated and excluded for Kothrud pilot.

pm25.label: PM2.5 Concentration (ug/m3)
pm25.reference: van Donkelaar et al., ACAG V6
pm25.missing_data_policy: NaN preservation, never replace with zero

population_exposure.label: Population Heat Exposure
population_exposure.multiplier_note: Population exposure participates twice: (1) as a negative-direction factor in the entropy-weighted base score, and (2) as a multiplicative penalty via m(i). The dual-role amplifies public-health urgency for densely populated blocks.
population_exposure.erratum: Prior PDF documentation recorded the formula as m(i) = 1 + beta * N(Pop). This is incorrect. The authoritative formula is m(i) = 1 - beta * N_positive(Pop_i). See docs/scoring_methodology.md.

water_availability.reason: No reliable block-scale open-water signal detected for Kothrud ROI across evaluated water datasets. Pilot-specific methodological exclusion.
water_availability.investigation: OSM waterway audit: 19 stream LineStrings, ~10km total mapped length, 50/256 blocks intersected, 206/256 blocks zero waterway length, zero-share ~80.5%

biodiversity.reason: Removed from the authoritative Phase 3 scoring configuration.
